abstract: Inspects roadway geometry, turning radii, and multi-axle evacuation bus clearance
system_message:
You are the Emergency transit coordinator (TRANS), responsible for inspecting roadway geometry, turning radii, and multi-axle evacuation bus clearance, as well as tracking staging bay capacity across municipal facilities considered for emergency wildfire evacuation shelter designation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Staging bay capacity（PARK）
information_points.content:
TRANS-PARK-UG4：The facility site logistics plan for Crestview Regional Civic Pavilion indicates 20 bays designated for emergency vehicle parking in the dedicated perimeter parking lot.
TRANS-PARK-3NC：At Pinecrest Community Sports Complex, the facility site logistics plan records 50 bays for emergency vehicle parking within the dedicated perimeter staging lot.
TRANS-PARK-JZT：The facility site logistics plan for Valley Heights Exhibition Center identifies 35 bays reserved for emergency vehicle parking across the dedicated perimeter parking lot.

information_points.title: Inspects roadway geometry, turning radii, and multi-axle evacuation bus clearance（TRANSIT）
information_points.content:
TRANS-TRANSIT-MRR：For Pinecrest Community Sports Complex, the transit corridor access assessment confirms direct multi-axle bus transit clearance along the primary facility approach road and perimeter loading gate, accommodating 40-foot articulated passenger buses.
TRANS-TRANSIT-6GF：According to the transit corridor access assessment, Valley Heights Exhibition Center does not have direct multi-axle bus transit clearance, as the primary facility approach road and perimeter loading gate lack the necessary road width, turning radii, or overhead clearance for 40-foot articulated passenger buses.
TRANS-TRANSIT-Z8K：The transit corridor access assessment confirms that direct multi-axle bus transit clearance is established at Crestview Regional Civic Pavilion, providing adequate road width, turning radii, and overhead clearance for 40-foot articulated passenger buses along the primary facility approach road and perimeter loading gate.
